principles.ui_rule: LOC1-8 are responsibility domains, not mandatory separate user-facing pages.
principles.misc_rule: New or unresolved cross-domain material may enter LOC8 temporarily and should move to a clearer primary owner when responsibility becomes stable.
principles.stable_framework_mutable_language: Stable identities, schemas, responsibility domains and provenance rules govern a language layer whose meanings, relations and interpretations may evolve.
principles.historical_integrity: Original records are retained; later interpretations may supersede but must not silently rewrite historical evidence.
principles.plurality: Competing interpretations may coexist when provenance, context and lifecycle status remain explicit.
principles.boundary_model: Govern by domain/scope/ownership/permission boundaries rather than a single universal moral bottom-line vocabulary.

analysis_boundary.LOC6: Meaning, values, governance, stage interpretation, style-state interpretation.
analysis_boundary.LOC7: Grammar, syntax, linguistic structure, semantic engineering, text architecture, retrieval structure.
analysis_boundary.LOC8: Does not own interpretive analysis; provides event, state, ERA, time, registry, and cross-LOC integration context.

rights_boundary.LOC6: Defines governance principles for authorship, attribution, sharing, licensing, and collaboration.
rights_boundary.LOC8: Maintains shared rights/provenance references and identity linkage.
rights_boundary.LOC3_LOC4_LOC5: Attach concrete work/media rights and provenance values by reference.

governance_control_plane.rule: A governance policy is not complete until Principle -> Policy -> Executable Control -> Evidence/Audit Trail can be demonstrated.

cross_domain_rule: A domain may reference, consume, analyze or propose changes to another domain's authoritative record, but must not overwrite that domain's canonical ownership.
